The base image is available at [bare-devcontainer/images (⭐3)](https://github.com/bare-devcontainer/images/tree/main/src/deno).

items.title: Awesome Rtc
items.content_text:
### Server Software / General Purpose

*   [FreeSWITCH (⭐5.3k)](https://github.com/signalwire/freeswitch) - Open source communications server for voice, video, messaging and conferencing.
*   [Asterisk](https://www.asterisk.org/) - PBX framework supporting multiple protocols and platforms.

### Server Software / SIP Servers

*   [Kamailio](https://www.kamailio.org/w/) - Open source SIP server for routing, registration, presence and large-scale deployments.
*   [OpenSIPS](https://opensips.org/) - Open source SIP proxy and application server for VoIP platforms.
*   [FreeSBC (⭐369)](https://github.com/rasonyang/freesbc) - Open source SIP/WebRTC edge proxy with an embedded RTP relay for FreeSWITCH and Asterisk.
*   [P-KISS-SBC (⭐114)](https://github.com/mwolff44/pk-sbc) - Kamailio and rtpengine-based session border controller for connecting SIP trunks and PBXs.

### Server Software / Media Servers

*   [LiveKit (⭐22k)](https://github.com/livekit/livekit) - Open source WebRTC server and SDK ecosystem for real-time audio, video and data.
*   [rtpengine (⭐1k)](https://github.com/sipwise/rtpengine) - RTP and UDP based media traffic proxy, usable as a kernel module.
*   [MediaMTX (⭐21k)](https://github.com/bluenviron/mediamtx) - Media server and proxy bridging WebRTC, RTSP, RTMP and SRT streams, with recording and playback.
*   [go2rtc (⭐15k)](https://github.com/AlexxIT/go2rtc) - Camera streaming gateway with WebRTC viewing, RTSP restreaming and two-way audio integrations.

### Server Software / STUN/TURN

*   [STUNner (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/l7mp/stunner) - Kubernetes-native STUN/TURN gateway for WebRTC media.

### Clients / STUN/TURN

*   [Web SIP Phone (⭐8)](https://github.com/rasonyang/web-sip-phone) - Chrome extension maintaining SIP/WebRTC audio for server-controlled call center agents.
*   [baresip (⭐2.3k)](https://github.com/baresip/baresip) - Modular SIP user agent with command-line controls, audio/video calls and pluggable media modules.

### Operations / Monitoring

*   [rtcStats (⭐47)](https://github.com/rtcstats/rtcstats) - WebRTC API trace and getStats collection, storage and feature extraction tooling.
*   [SIP3 Community Edition](https://sip3.io/docs/InstallationGuide.html) - Open source SIP/RTP capture, analysis and monitoring components with community deployment tooling.

### Operations / Testing

*   [SIPp (⭐1.2k)](https://github.com/SIPp/sipp) - Traffic generator and scenario-based test tool for the SIP protocol.

### Operations / Web/API Interfaces

*   [Kazoo (⭐992)](https://github.com/2600hz/kazoo/tree/4.3) - Legacy open source VoIP API platform built on FreeSWITCH and Kamailio, available in the public 4.3 branch.
*   [AI Native Call Center (⭐659)](https://github.com/rasonyang/ai-native-callcenter) - FreeSWITCH-based call center with speech-to-speech AI, agent queues and a web interface/API.

### Operations / Billing

*   [CGRateS (⭐528)](https://github.com/cgrates/cgrates) - Open source rating, charging and billing engine for telecom and ISP services.

### Developer Resources / Tutorials

*   [WebRTC.org](https://webrtc.org/) - Official WebRTC guides, APIs and project resources.
*   [Getting Started With WebRTC](https://webrtc.org/getting-started/overview) - Official introduction to media capture and peer-to-peer connectivity APIs.
*   [WebRTC for the Curious](https://webrtcforthecurious.com/) - Open book explaining WebRTC protocols, architecture and practical debugging.

### Developer Resources / JavaScript Libraries

*   [JsSIP](https://jssip.net/) - Open source JavaScript SIP library with WebRTC media support.
*   [Peerix (⭐7)](https://github.com/meefik/peerix) - TypeScript WebRTC library for peer-to-peer media and data with pluggable signalling drivers.
*   [werift (⭐649)](https://github.com/shinyoshiaki/werift-webrtc) - TypeScript WebRTC implementation for Node.js with media, data channels and RTP/RTCP APIs.

### Developer Resources / C/C++ Libraries

*   [libre (⭐195)](https://github.com/baresip/re) - Portable SIP, SDP, RTP, SRTP and ICE/STUN/TURN library with asynchronous I/O.
*   [icey (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/auscaster/icey) - C++20 media toolkit combining WebRTC, FFmpeg, asynchronous networking and signalling.
*   [GStreamer WebRTC](https://gstreamer.freedesktop.org/documentation/webrtc/) - WebRTC elements for connecting native GStreamer media pipelines to browser peers.

### Developer Resources / Rust Libraries

*   [WebRTC.rs (⭐5.2k)](https://github.com/webrtc-rs/webrtc) - Asynchronous WebRTC implementation in Rust with SDP, RTP, RTCP and SRTP support.

### Developer Resources / Dart Libraries

*   [dart-sip-ua (⭐374)](https://github.com/flutter-webrtc/dart-sip-ua) - Dart SIP user-agent stack with SIP over WebSocket and WebRTC media support.
*   [Flutter WebRTC (⭐4.5k)](https://github.com/flutter-webrtc/flutter-webrtc) - WebRTC bindings for Flutter applications on mobile, desktop and the web.

### Developer Resources / Media over QUIC

*   [moq-rs (⭐186)](https://github.com/cloudflare/moq-rs) - Rust implementation of Media over QUIC Transport with a relay and sample publishers.
*   [moq (⭐1.6k)](https://github.com/moq-dev/moq) - Rust and TypeScript libraries, relay and browser player implementing moq-lite.
*   [moqtail (⭐114)](https://github.com/moqtail/moqtail) - Rust and TypeScript Media over QUIC Transport libraries with a relay and example clients.
*   [moxygen (⭐127)](https://github.com/facebookexperimental/moxygen) - C++ Media over QUIC Transport library with a relay, sample applications and interoperability tools.
*   [libquicr (⭐21)](https://github.com/Quicr/libquicr) - C++ Media over QUIC Transport library with publish, subscribe, capture and replay tools.
*   [imquic (⭐82)](https://github.com/meetecho/imquic) - Experimental C library for QUIC and WebTransport with RTP over QUIC and Media over QUIC Transport support.

### Blogs / Media over QUIC

*   [WebRTC For Developers](https://www.webrtc-developers.com/) - Articles, examples and tools for WebRTC application developers.

### Discussion / Media over QUIC

*   [FreeSWITCH Community](https://signalwire.community) - Discord community for FreeSWITCH and SignalWire users and developers.
*   [discuss-webrtc](https://groups.google.com/g/discuss-webrtc) - Developer discussion group for WebRTC APIs, implementations and interoperability.

### Events and Talks / Media over QUIC

*   [ClueCon](https://www.cluecon.com/) - Conference for communications and voice AI developers.
*   [Kamailio World](https://www.kamailio.org/w/category/kamailio-world/) - Conference announcements and technical sessions covering Kamailio and open source RTC systems.
*   [AstriCon](https://www.asterisk.org/astricon/) - Conference for Asterisk and FreePBX developers and users.
*   [CommCon](https://commcon.xyz/) - RTC and open-media community events with a technical talk archive.
*   [OpenSIPS Summit](https://www.opensips.org/Community/Summits) - OpenSIPS community conferences with technical presentations and proceedings.
*   [JanusCon](https://www.januscon.it/2024/) - Conference proceedings and technical talks for Janus and WebRTC developers.
*   [TADHack](https://blog.tadhack.com/) - Telecom application hackathons, demos and event announcements.

### Related Lists / Media over QUIC

*   [Awesome Asterisk (⭐13)](https://github.com/ictinnovations/awesome-asterisk) - Asterisk tooling: ARI, AMI and AGI libraries, call audio streaming, voice AI and testing.
*   [Awesome FreeSWITCH (⭐4)](https://github.com/ictinnovations/awesome-freeswitch) - FreeSWITCH tooling: Event Socket libraries, call audio streaming, distributions and monitoring.

items.title: Awesome Computational Biology
items.content_text:
### Drug Response & Perturbation

*   [scCT-DB](http://scctdb.ncpsb.org.cn) — Cancer treatment single-cell database with 266 paired pre/post-treatment datasets, 6.19M cells, 1,142 samples, 27 cancer types, and 102 drugs.
*   [scICB](http://www.scimmnue.com/) — Pan-cancer ICB therapy single-cell database spanning 338 patients, 807 samples, 3.69M cells, and 13 cancer types, including 247 matched pre/post-treatment patients.
*   [CellResDB](https://cellknowledge.com.cn/cellresponse) — Cancer therapy response single-cell database containing 4.7M cells from 1,391 patient samples, 72 datasets, and 24 cancer types.
*   [Gondal et al. 2025 ICB scRNA-seq collection](https://cellxgene.cziscience.com/collections/61e422dd-c9cd-460e-9b91-72d9517348ef) — Integrated ICB-treated cancer single-cell collection from eight studies and 223 patients, with 90,270 cancer cells and 265,671 other cells.

### Genetic Perturbation & Perturb-seq

*   [scPerturbBench (TianGzlab / PerturbArena) (⭐11)](https://github.com/TianGzlab/scPerturbBench) — Benchmark of single-cell genetic perturbation prediction covering unseen perturbations, combinations, cell-state transfer, and 24 evaluation metrics.
*   [scPerturBench (BM2 Lab) (⭐110)](https://github.com/bm2-lab/scPerturBench) — Benchmark comparing 27 single-cell perturbation-response prediction methods across 29 genetic and chemical perturbation datasets.

### General Biological ML & Knowledge Graph Benchmarks

*   [CellBench (CellVoyager) (⭐273)](https://github.com/zou-group/CellVoyager/tree/main/CellBench) — Benchmark for evaluating LLMs and data-analysis agents on reproducible single-cell research tasks.

### Preprocessing Tools

*   [SpatialData](https://spatialdata.scverse.org/) — Interoperable data structures and tooling for spatial omics, microscopy images, coordinates, segmentation shapes, and annotations.

### Bioinformatics & Omics Agents

*   [CellVoyager (⭐273)](https://github.com/zou-group/CellVoyager) — Jupyter-based scientific agent that plans, executes, and evaluates single-cell transcriptomics analyses, accompanied by CellBench.

### Single-cell Foundation Models / Transcriptomics Foundation Models

*   [Cell2Sentence / C2S-Scale (⭐896)](https://github.com/vandijklab/cell2sentence) — Single-cell language-model family representing gene-expression profiles as cell sentences for cellular interpretation, generation, and question answering.

### Multi-Modal Foundation Models / Protein Structure Prediction and Design

*   [TxGemma](https://deepmind.google/models/gemma/txgemma/) — Open Gemma-based therapeutic-development model family (2B, 9B, and 27B) for property prediction and interactive scientific reasoning.
*   [NVIDIA Nemotron for Science](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-introduces-nemotron-for-science-to-accelerate-discoveries-with-agents) — Scientific-agent development stack based on Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, with post-training recipes and chemistry reasoning benchmark LitmusBench v0.2.

  • scPerturBench (BM2 Lab) (⭐110) — Benchmark comparing 27 single-cell perturbation-response prediction methods across 29 genetic and chemical perturbation datasets.

General Biological ML & Knowledge Graph Benchmarks

  • CellBench (CellVoyager) (⭐273) — Benchmark for evaluating LLMs and data-analysis agents on reproducible single-cell research tasks.

Preprocessing Tools

  • SpatialData — Interoperable data structures and tooling for spatial omics, microscopy images, coordinates, segmentation shapes, and annotations.

Bioinformatics & Omics Agents

  • CellVoyager (⭐273) — Jupyter-based scientific agent that plans, executes, and evaluates single-cell transcriptomics analyses, accompanied by CellBench.

Single-cell Foundation Models / Transcriptomics Foundation Models

  • Cell2Sentence / C2S-Scale (⭐896) — Single-cell language-model family representing gene-expression profiles as cell sentences for cellular interpretation, generation, and question answering.

Multi-Modal Foundation Models / Protein Structure Prediction and Design

  • TxGemma — Open Gemma-based therapeutic-development model family (2B, 9B, and 27B) for property prediction and interactive scientific reasoning.
  • NVIDIA Nemotron for Science — Scientific-agent development stack based on Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, with post-training recipes and chemistry reasoning benchmark LitmusBench v0.2.

items.content_text:
### Commands & Extensions

*   [Revenue Skills (⭐0)](https://github.com/moonetix/revenue-skills) - Gemini CLI extension with 11 Agent Skills for code that handles money: an audit of payment, credit and payout paths that reports each bug with file, line and a request proof or code trace, and skills that build webhook endpoints, ledgers, refunds, usage credits, subscriptions, payouts, referrals and sign-up abuse guards. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/moonetix/revenue-skills`

*   [Taskhold](https://taskhold.com/?ref=awesome-gemini-cli) - Hosted MCP server that gives Gemini CLI a task list you share: next task, steps, live progress and blocked questions you answer from a web board. 23 tools, remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth. Paid, $12/month, 7-day trial.
